limb.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite asset for a 2D gothic action game that retains a thin articulated stick skeleton. ONE isolated narrow straight cloth-covered limb segment, oriented vertically. It will be stretched and rotated as an arm or leg, only 8-12 pixels wide in gameplay. Design for that tiny final scale. Shape: a slim slightly tapered sleeve/trouser section, almost straight sides with two subtle angular fabric breaks, width to height around 1:5. End edges are plain dark flat cut joints for overlap, NOT swollen rounded caps. Material: matte charcoal woven clothing, not leather armor. Paint this as a crisp hand-INKED 2D game sprite: solid dark outline, one broad medium slate-charcoal flat face, one narrow darker side shadow, only two or three clear angular cloth fold marks. Flat color blocks and intentional ink shapes, no gradients across the width, no round cylindrical volume. A small simple muted grey cuff seam near lower end is allowed, not a bracelet. Silhouette and broad fold shapes must read at postage stamp scale. Moderate value contrast against dark teal walls, main cloth around desaturated #596165, shadow #293336, thin outline #141C1F. NO metal, NO armor plates, NO specular shine, NO reflective central highlight, NO smooth 3D shading, NO pores/noise/fine texture, NO rubber, NO sausage/capsule shape, NO human flesh, NO hands/feet/shoulder/joint balls. This must look drawn and fabric-clad, not a photographed object. Single sprite centered with generous transparent margin; genuine transparent background, no background halo, no text or labels.

torso.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One modular torso sprite for a very slim articulated 2D gothic stick-skeleton hunter. No head, no arms, no legs. A short fitted sleeveless dark burgundy waistcoat over charcoal clothing, drawn as ONE narrow vertical torso section, width to height approximately 1:4.5, not a full person. Top shoulder/neck attachment is a plain flat cut, bottom at waist is also a plain dark flat cut. Subtle angular narrowing at waist, no bulbous rounded ends. Compact V shaped overlap collar near the upper end, one simple charcoal diagonal opening seam and at most two large angular cloth folds. The upper half may have muted dusty burgundy (#61434A) broad face, darker oxblood shadow (#362B32); lower joining half is mostly consistent charcoal grey (#434F52) so two skeletal torso segments join unobtrusively. Style: restrained hand-inked flat 2D game art, solid dark outline and 2-3 crisp flat color planes only, broad readable folds, truly matte wool fabric, designed to shrink to a torso only 12 pixels wide. No smooth gradients, no bright center shine, no round cylindrical shading, no photoreal texture, no fabric noise, no pores. NO armor, NO metal plate, NO breastplate, NO buckles, NO shoulder pads, NO cape, NO flowing fabric, NO rubber or inflated capsule shape, NO skin. Balanced midtone faces to remain readable against dark teal stone walls, not pitch black. One sprite centered, straight upright, genuinely transparent background with generous margins; no glow/halo/shadow/backdrop, no text.
